teaser: Where assist becomes execute: tier AI agents by reach and undo class, enforce each tier with a boundary, and learn from the rule that failed.
core_idea: Answering Khwaja Naveed: Agent Behaviour Policies tier by capability, not agent. Each capability (verb.object.reach) has an undo class (yes, with-effort, no), giving four tiers: assist (logged), change own work (signed, reviewable), change a system of record (plan then apply, enforced above the agent), irreversible to the world (drafts only or unreachable). Only a boundary enforced above the grant bounds anything; our conductor's rule against pushing to main failed once because branch protection was not set.
